items.basis: Fastmarkets aluminium primary foundry alloy silicon 7 ingot premium, ddp Eastern Europe (MB-AL-0340), and the ddp Germany premium (MB-AL-0339): both 950-1,050 USD/t on 29 May 2026 (price-agency assessment; the 22 May print of 1,000-1,100 was deleted as published in error). Mid 1,000/1000 x 3.849 = 3.85 PLN/kg. Duty-paid and delivered, CBAM costs included from Jan 2026.
items.notes: Range 950-1,050 = 3.66-4.04 PLN/kg. Corrected May average for ddp Germany: low 975 / high 1,075 USD/t (https://www.fastmarkets.com/insights/correction-to-may-averages-for-aluminium-primary-foundry-alloy-premiums/). Earlier all-time high 900-1,000 USD/t on 11 March (https://www.fastmarkets.com/insights/european-us-aluminium-pfa-premiums-hit-new-all-time-highs/; year read from context of the Strait of Hormuz closure, page date not confirmed). Fastmarkets moved the PFA premiums to twice a month (notice ~24 Sep 2026, https://www.fastmarkets.com/insights/increase-in-frequency-of-fastmarkets-european-aluminium-pfa-premiums/) but no Jun-Oct print was found. The P1020 Rotterdam premium eased from ~575-600 USD/t (2 Apr) to 490-520 (8 Sep) before recovering to 545-574 (1 Oct), so the October PFA premium may be somewhat below the May figure - inference, not a quote.

items.basis: DERIVED, company annual report: Novelis Inc. Form 10-K FY2026 (year to 31 Mar 2026), Europe segment net sales 5,272 million USD / total shipments 1,115 kt = 4,728 USD/t; x 3.849/1000 = 18.20 PLN/kg. Average selling price of Europe's largest flat-rolled producer, all products (can, automotive, specialty) incl. metal; ex-works mix, no VAT.
items.notes: FY2025 for comparison: 4,606 / 1,083 = 4,253 USD/t (16.37 PLN/kg). Segment figures include intersegment sales and affiliates on a proportionate basis (per the 10-K). The FY2026 metal price averaged below Sep-Oct 2026 levels (LME rose to ~3,385 USD/t by early March 2026 and Rotterdam premium roughly doubled through 2026), so an October 2026 sheet price is likely ABOVE this average - inference. Mix is dominated by can stock, which has the lowest conversion; automotive body sheet (6016/6111/5754) sells above the mix. Not a grade-specific price.

Held book figures that look wrong: (1) mat-al6082-forge 16.40 and mat-al6061-forge 16.90 are BELOW or equal to delivered 6063 extrusion billet (round 1: 16.75) and below the book's own 6082 billet (17.15) - forging stock is extruded/cast bar made from billet, so it cannot cost less: too low. (2) mat-al6082-bar 17.66 and mat-al6061 18.01 are only ~0.9-1.3 PLN/kg over delivered billet before any extrusion conversion: likely too low. (3) Sheet: mat-aa3003-sheet 15.13, mat-aa1050-sheet 15.23, mat-aa5182/5052 16.14, mat-aa5754-sheet 16.80, mat-aa6016-t4 17.66 sit only 0.6-3.2 PLN/kg over P1020 (14.15-14.50) and BELOW Novelis Europe's FY2026 all-product average selling price (18.20 PLN/kg, at lower metal prices than today) - likely too low, especially auto body sheet 6016/6111 which sells above the can-dominated mix.
